title: 第25章 见面礼第26章 齐心协力
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙

“师父，你回来了！”
花玲珑首先迎了上来，“我家在这附近正好有一个院子，这几天就去那里休息吧。”
这倒是让寂月有点惊喜了，她刚刚还在愁待会去哪里休息，没想到一下子就解决了。
收一个土豪徒弟就是爽！
寂琳和莫离两个小孩，被照顾的周周到到，两人手里都有零嘴，身后的叶无忧手里大包小包的东西不少。
宁青青出山没多久，所以看什么事都觉得好奇，也跟俩小孩一样，手里捧着很多零食。
“师父，这城里好热闹啊。我阿婆以前一直说外面的坏人很多，所以不让我出山，但是没想到这外面这么好玩。”
看着一脸单纯的宁青青，寂月心下叹了口气，这也就是没有产生什么利益纠纷，所以看着很安全。
这要是在秘境里，陌生人能坑的你怀疑人生。
“小师妹，你阿婆说的的确没错，你想想我之前跟你说的那个渣男，是不是坏人？”花玲珑凑了过去，纠正她的想法。
“那对狗男女，要不是有风灵宗给他们做后盾，我真想冲上去揍他们一顿。可惜啊，我修为不够，还是得努力才行。”
就是现在想到这件事，她还是气得肺疼。
尽管她也不怎么喜欢那个未婚夫，但毕竟花家在他身上倾注的资源不少，而且她爹也确实把他当成半个儿子看待，但是没想到会有这种算计。
宁青青想到这个，脸色立马就变了，“我错了，我不该看事情这么简单的。”
叶无忧几人也了解了花玲珑那件事，入门的时候就卖了一波惨，也是为了能尽快融入进来。
家丑为什么不能外扬？家丑就是要外扬，丢人的又不是她，是那个渣男啊！
“花师妹说的没错，但这个世界也不是这么绝对的。有恶必有善，有危险的地方就一定会有安全的地方。你阿婆只是怕你受到伤害，所以才这么说，但如果你有保护自己的能力，也不用惧怕什么坏人。”
宁青青不好意思的低下头，她年纪虽然不是最小的，但是这些人当中最单纯的，因为没经过社会的毒打。
最小的寂琳比她懂得多点，毕竟村子里那点事，也不怎么单纯。

至于莫离，暂时不清楚这孩子身上发生了什么，但是没有父母在身边的孩子都早熟。
花玲珑说的院子在翡城比较寂静的一个区域，这边的房子跟皇城根的区域差不多，富贵。
偌大的一个院子，在阵法的加持下，即便没怎么住人，也依旧干净整洁。
“我这次正好也是代表花家参加拍卖会，到时候有喜欢的东西，记得跟我说，我帮你们拍下来！”花玲珑很是臭屁的挑了挑眉。
叶无忧白了她一眼，“你倒是财大气粗，我倒也做不出这没品的事来。”
“客气什么，当是我给大家的见面礼好了。”花玲珑不在意的说。
说到见面礼，寂月想起来这几个弟子，她好像什么也没给。
但是，除了寂琳是她死皮赖脸收下来的，其他人都是他们“主动”的啊！
“咳咳！为师近日炼了些丹药，你们分了吧。”她想了想还是不能这么吝啬，要做一个大方的师父。
洗髓丹还可以炼，但是徒弟的感情要维护好。
“这是洗髓丹？”叶无忧看着里面的丹药，惊讶道。
“嗯，一人一颗，不可贪多。无忧，你此前虽然服用过一颗，但不必担心，它只会改善你的体质。”之前那颗药效太差了。
洗髓丹，顾名思义，能洗筋伐髓，提升人的资质。

"Master, you are back!"
Hua Linglong came up to her first, "My house happens to have a yard near here. Let's go there to rest in the past few days."
This was a bit of a surprise to Jiyue. Just now, she was worried about where to rest later, but she didn't expect it to be solved all at once.
It’s great to have a wealthy disciple as your apprentice!
The two children, Ji Lin and Li Qi Li, were taken good care of. They both had snacks in their hands, and Ye Wuyou behind him had a lot of big and small bags in his hands.
Ning Qingqing had not been out of the mountains for long, so she was curious about everything. Like the two children, she held a lot of snacks in her hands.
"Master, this city is so lively. My grandma used to say there were a lot of bad people outside, so she wouldn't let me go out, but I didn't expect it to be so fun outside."
Looking at the innocent Ning Qingqing, Jiyue sighed in her heart. This meant that there was no conflict of interest, so it looked very safe.
If this were in a secret realm, strangers could trick you into doubting your life.
"Little junior sister, what your grandma said is indeed correct. Think about it, is that scumbag I told you before a bad person?" Hua Linglong came over and corrected her thoughts.
"That couple of bitches, if they didn't have the support of Fengling Sect, I really want to rush up and beat them up. It's a pity, my cultivation is not enough, I still have to work hard."
Even now when she thought about it, she was still so angry that her lungs ached.
Although she didn't like her fiancé very much, after all, the Hua family invested a lot of resources in him, and her father did treat him as half a son, but she didn't expect such a calculation.
When Ning Qingqing thought of this, her expression immediately changed, "I was wrong, I shouldn't have looked at things so simply."
Ye Wuyou and others also learned about Hua Linglong's incident, and they had a hard time when they first started, just to integrate in as soon as possible.
Why shouldn’t family scandals be publicized? Family scandals are meant to be publicized, and it’s not her who’s embarrassed, it’s that scumbag!
"Junior sister Hua is right, but this world is not so absolute. Where there is evil, there must be good, and where there is danger, there must be a safe place. Your grandma is just afraid that you will be hurt, that's why she said this, but if you have the ability to protect yourself, you don't have to be afraid of bad people."
Ning Qingqing lowered her head in embarrassment. Although she was not the youngest, she was the most innocent among these people because she had not been beaten by society.
Jilin, the youngest, knows more than she does. After all, things in the village are not very simple.
As for Mo Li, it is not clear what happened to the child, but children without parents around them mature prematurely.
The courtyard Hua Linglong was talking about is in a relatively quiet area of ​​Feicheng. The houses here are similar to those in the Imperial City root area, rich and noble.
A huge courtyard, with the blessing of the formation, is still clean and tidy even if there are not many people living there.
"I happen to be participating in the auction on behalf of the Hua family this time. If you have something you like, remember to tell me and I will take a photo of it for you!" Hua Linglong raised her eyebrows in a very disgusting manner.
Ye Wuyou rolled his eyes at her, "You are rich and powerful, but I can't do such a dishonorable thing."
"Why are you so polite? Just think of it as a meeting gift from me." Hua Linglong said nonchalantly.
Speaking of the meeting gift, Jiyue thought of these disciples and it seemed like she had given them nothing.
However, except for Ji Lin who was shamelessly accepted by her, everyone else was their "initiative"!
"Ahem! I have made some elixirs recently. You guys can share them." She thought about it and decided not to be so stingy. She wanted to be a generous master.
You can still practice the Marrow Cleansing Pill, but the disciple's emotions must be protected.
"Is this the marrow cleansing pill?" Ye Wuyou looked at the pill inside and asked in surprise.
"Well, one pill for each person, don't be greedy for more. Wuyou, although you have taken one pill before, don't worry, it will only improve your physical condition." The previous pill was too effective.Bad.
Marrow Cleansing Pill, as the name suggests, can cleanse muscles and cut marrow, improving people's qualifications.
